  "description": "As an IT Internal Audit Manager, your main responsibilities will include:\n* Lead and develop Group-wide IT Internal Audit initiatives\n* Design, Implement and develop the IT Audit practice at Group level;\n* Support Department Head in planning and implementation of the Annual IT Internal Audit Plan;\n* Lead the planning and execution of IT internal audit engagements/ Own end-to-end IT audit engagements from planning through reporting.\n* Execute IT audit projects within budgeted time and best practices;\n* Review IT audit projects working papers, ensuring completeness and assertiveness of conclusions and propose control recommendations to mitigate risks;\n* Review audit findings and provide practical risk mitigation and control recommendations.\n* Prepare audit reports for assurance and consulting engagements and hold audit Exit Meetings with key audit stakeholders and Management;\n* Present audit results and engage with senior stakeholders and management teams.\n* Follow up on action plans implementation and remediation of audit findings, prepare status update progress report and perform retesting as required;\n* Monitor remediation actions and ensure audit findings are effectively resolved.\n* Advanced command of IT environment and IT governance and controls, namely Cybersecurity and AI related;\n* Support Process Audit teams in specific ITGC related audit procedures;",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n5 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  3 năm kinh nghiệm quản lý  Đại Học trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\n· Completed higher education degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Information Security/Cybersecurity, Data Processing or Systems Analysis;\n· **Prior experience in IT Audit, IT Risk Consulting, IT Risk Management,**\n· **Advanced knowledge in English**\n\nKiến thức ngành\nAn ninh mạng, Kiểm toán, IT - Phần cứng và máy tính"
